status: S0 fit-article files available; physical fit/load qualification and powered operation not released
destination: Four independently articulated tracked flippers; stair climbing remains a later qualification target.
first_vehicle: Two reusable track modules held by fixed printed brackets; Pi, OpenCR, LiDAR, camera and microphone retained in the research-platform plan.
reference_hash_scope: SHA256 of the STEP DATA section, excluding export timestamps. Geometry verified against previously pinned full files before transition.

interface_policy.track_module: Retain drive motor, wheels, idler hub, track and tensioner across stages. A replaceable root adapter connects the four M4 holes to a future supported pivot. This pattern is a candidate, not a demonstrated stair-load interface.
interface_policy.fixed_mounts: Two removable brackets per module bolt to the existing chassis grid. Their four module holes are separate from the future root interface; no pitch motor carries static loads in S1.
interface_policy.future_placement: The first pair is centered longitudinally for floor driving. Reposition it to front or rear when adding the second pair and pivots. Future sweep, pivot packaging and chassis strength remain to be resolved.
interface_policy.wiring: Separate detachable TTL power/data lead to each track motor. Keep the body-side route and replace only the module flex section when articulation is added.
interface_policy.fabrication: S1 uses printed brackets plus ordinary bought bearings, bolts, nuts and washers. No custom metal hub, gearbox rail or machined coupling is specified for S1. Future pivot fabrication is unresolved.

parts.item: XL430-W250-T track motor
parts.action: Reuse owned motors; pitch actuators are additional and deferred.

parts.item: Bare TB3 ISW sprocket, tyre removed
parts.action: Reuse compatible stock; verify actual count.

parts.item: ICT-01 link
parts.action: Reuse stock; qualify engagement and tension on one module.

parts.item: Track carrier S1
parts.action: New candidate print after fit checks; earlier printed arms remain superseded.

parts.item: Tip hub with rear retaining-cap pilots
parts.action: Reprint P3; earlier uncapped hub lacks positive axial retention. Retain 19.3 mm bore candidate; qualify complete stack.

parts.item: Idler bearing cap
parts.action: P8 idler_bearing_cap_s1.stl; Ø30 x 2, Ø17 opening, 0.2 mm bearing relief. Countersinks face carrier; fit before mounting hub on carrier.

parts.item: M2 x 6 DIN965 Phillips countersunk screw
parts.action: H8 cap screws, 6 mm overall INCLUDING flat head; head Ø3.8 max x 1.2, PH0. Three printed Ø1.7 x 5 blind pilots on Ø24 PCD; about 4 mm engagement. No washers or nuts. Do not substitute larger ISO10642 socket countersunk heads.

parts.item: 626 bearing, 6 x 19 x 6 mm
parts.action: Ordinary bought bearing; confirm stock.

parts.item: Idler inner-race spacer, 3 mm
parts.action: Reuse after fit; check clamp preload does not bind hub.

parts.item: M6 x 50 partially threaded socket bolt, 26 mm plain shank
parts.action: Idler axle; threaded portion must not support either bearing.

parts.item: M6 washer and M6 nyloc nut
parts.action: One set per axle. Washer OD12, bore6.4, thickness1.6 mm; nut 10 mm across flats, 6 mm high. Washer seats in carrier's 0.6 mm recess.

parts.item: Supplied M2.6 x 5 tapping case screw
parts.action: Use both horn-side row holes on each wall: module X50/74, Z33. Verify 2 mm wall under each head; loaded fixing remains unqualified.

parts.item: M2 x 4 wheel screw
parts.action: Four per wheel; check thread engagement in horn and printed hub.

parts.item: Fixed bracket S1
parts.action: Temporary printed item; retain as bench fixture after pivot installation.

parts.item: Drive-lead restraint S1
parts.action: Printed stand on existing chassis holes X=-56/-48, Y=+/-64. Cable centre X=-51, Y=+/-64, Z=46.25. Print on broad side as exported.

parts.item: M3 x 16 socket bolt, two washers and nyloc nut
parts.action: Lead-restraint base: bolts from below chassis. Washers OD7/bore3.2/thickness0.5; nut AF5.5/height4; head OD5.5/height3 mm.

parts.item: Nylon cable tie, 2.5 x 100 mm
parts.action: Through both restraint-top slots; close over lead without crushing its insulation.

parts.item: M4 x 25 socket bolt, two washers and nyloc nut
parts.action: One set per fixed module hole. Each washer OD9, bore4.3, thickness0.8 mm; nut 7 mm across flats, 5 mm high; head OD7, height4 mm. Larger washers can foul bracket foot. Future root fasteners depend on pivot adapter thickness.

parts.item: M3 x 20 socket bolt, two washers and nyloc nut
parts.action: One set per bracket foot hole. Each washer OD7, bore3.2, thickness0.5 mm; nut 5.5 mm across flats, 4 mm high; head OD5.5, height3 mm. Qualify clamping on the printed chassis.

parts.item: ROBOTIS X3P 180 mm JST-JST TTL lead
parts.action: Reuse lead supplied with XL430. Lower route from motor side exit to chassis restraint: 43.85 mm, R12, bundle OD<=4.5 mm. Fit plug before seating motor; retain remaining tail for later OpenCR routing. Four-flipper lead lengths are not established by S1.

whole_system_design: ../docs/assembly/s1-system-plan.md; H01-H10 and W01-W16 are authoritative for remaining current-robot integration

system_requirements.detail: Two independent supplies: owned LB-012 drive/OpenCR, separate USB-C compute candidate. Coil-interrupted relay stop, budgets, fuse proposals and USB/full-charge compatibility holds are specified in the whole-system design. Later flipper power is separate.
A1, cable and external interface board are owned. Revision, mounting bridge, interface holder, connector and peak current remain H02. Former 55 mm pillar allowance is not a purchase specification.

Pi 4B, Camera Module 3 Standard and WM8960 stereo microphones confirmed. Pi assumed bare without cooler. H01 resolves HAT supports/cooling; H03 resolves existing pan/tilt interference and servo/ribbon interfaces. U2 adapter columns are not HAT pillars.

Timestamp camera, audio, scans, IMU and drive feedback at capture; record sequence gaps, clock mapping, calibration/frame transforms and motor-on/off state. No native LiDAR encoding or exercised autonomous behavior is implied.

stages.build: One track module on a bench
stages.exit: Printed fit, bolt and plug access, hand-driven engagement/tension, then supported powered runs and measured motor temperature/load.

stages.build: Two fixed modules and complete research payload
stages.exit: Loaded driving/turning/stopping, power stability, support/clearance, and timestamped LiDAR/camera/audio capture.

stages.build: One supported pitch joint on a bench
stages.exit: Cost, fabrication, sustained load, speed, holding/stop behavior, referencing and cable motion demonstrated before duplication.

stages.build: Additional pair and qualified powered pivots
stages.exit: Integrated four-module contact/strength/propulsion tests; restrained step tests before any stair capability claim.

release_blockers: fixed bracket and chassis load/creep testing
actual payload mass and center of gravity
loaded skid steering and motor heating
exact upper hardware and LiDAR scan clearance
